pred_findings.quote: Post-op follow-up, cholecystectomy 8 days ago. Incision well-healed, no signs of infection. Patient reports mild fatigue. Discharged from surgical care.
pred_findings.explanation: Cholecystectomy has a post-operative global surgical window under the SOMB; routine post-op follow-up care furnished by the operating surgeon (or an associate) within that window is included in the surgical fee and is not separately billable. The encounter occurred only 8 days post-op, well within the global period. A separate E/M (03.04A) should not be billed unless the visit is unrelated to the surgery or significantly beyond the normal post-op course, neither of which is documented here (incision well-healed, no signs of infection, discharged from surgical care).

Z48.815 (encounter for surgical aftercare following surgery on the digestive system) is an appropriate diagnosis for post-cholecystectomy follow-up.
